Become the strongest Mobian...

[THIS IS THE OLD FRAMEWORK AND NOT THE RELEASE, WE ARE LETTING PEOPLE PLAY BEFORE WE RELEASE TO COMPARE THE OLD AND NEW VERSIONS OF THE GAME FOR WHEN THE TIME COMES, THIS IS NOT THE RELEASE (yet)!!]

⭐ If you enjoy the game please consider liking and favoriting the game for more updates! ⭐
Available on all devices. [Console, PC, and Mobile 📱💻🎮]

[CONTROLS]:
4M1s + frontdash near wall = wallcombo
F or X/Square - Block
Q or Y/Triangle - Dash
LeftClick or B/Circle - M1
LShift or DpadDown - Shiftlock
B or DpadRight - EmoteWheel
